diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a moderate downward trend (a net fall of ~35% of its level). There is little seasonal structure. Predictability is middling — structured signal and irregular noise are balanced. The series reads as non-stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. A few outliers stand out (3 points, ~1% of the sample). Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau 0.298), which favours a robust combination.
